name: QueuePlayerMarkerRingDraw
evidence: original assembly: by the player's sub-state (+0x2228) picks DrawPlayerMarkerRing1, 2 or 3, queues it in a cleared request (QueueDeferredRequest), and pulses a value from the times at 0x26C8 to 0x26D0 (Cosine) into the object tree (SetObjectTreeRecordValue); DrawPlayer calls it

name: GetPlayerRequestPhase
evidence: slot 77 of class 0x07: returns 0 or 1 from the pending flag 0x26C4 outside state 4, and in state 4 returns 1 below sub-state 45 and 2 from there

name: FinishPlayerRequest
evidence: slot 80 of class 0x07: clears the flag 0x2730, runs the stored callback at 0x26C0 or else moves itself up by the minimum height and enters state 2 sub-state 6, then clears 0x226C

name: NotifyPlayerGroundObject
evidence: when the player has a ground object at +0x2438, tests a point under it (ProbeColliderBelowPoint) and sends it an OwnerMessage of mode 3 on landing, then sends a hit message (kind 4 or 0x24) to each recently touched object whose height range holds the hit

name: ProbeColliderBelowPoint
evidence: original assembly: tests a vertical segment through the player's position (+0x140, from D_00275168 above to D_00275164 below) against a collider's tree (+0x3F8, func_0013DFD8), shifted by the displacement of the collider's oscillator (+0x278, ComputeOscillatorDisplacement), and writes the hit point; func_001D66A8 and the player's func_001D6B18 call it

name: ApplyPlayerAttachedSetContact
evidence: slot 0x128 of class 0x07: in states 6 and 0x2B (falling) runs ApplyColliderAttachedSetContact, in 0x27 and 0x2F adds a force that lifts the player along the set's surface motion with a clamped ramp, otherwise ApplyColliderAttachedSetContact

name: SwapInPlayerStandIn
evidence: the script built-in func_00105CC0 calls it: when the player has a class 0x3F object at +0x1518, adds it to its parent's list (slot 2), clears its parent (ReparentCollider), copies the frame of the first attached object of the four at +0x1508 (else of +0x1504) with CopyPlacedObjectFrame, stamps the clock at +0x690, sets +0x694 to 1 and removes that object from its parent's list (slot 3)

name: TestStandInMayContact
evidence: slot 56 of class 0x3F, the stand-in SwapInPlayerStandIn places: returns 1 for the player (g_player) and otherwise asks TestCollidersMayContact

name: StepStandIn
evidence: slot 28 of class 0x3F (the stand-in SwapInPlayerStandIn places), its override of StepCollider

name: StopStandIn
evidence: slot 60 of class 0x3F: runs the base func_0013BA70 and clears the running flag at +0x694 that SwapInPlayerStandIn sets

name: HandleStandInNotification
evidence: slot 13 of class 0x3F: runs HandleChildGroupNotification and, for a kind 10 message about itself, clears the running flag at +0x694 that SwapInPlayerStandIn sets

name: InitOwnerMessage
evidence: clears 0x10 bytes then stores a mode (0 or 2 from callers) at 0 and the owner object at 4 and 8; callers pass it to a virtual slot of another object

name: StoreVectorTailPathFollower
evidence: original assembly with no entry and no return: 20 bytes after InitOwnerMessage's jr that free 16 bytes of stack, store $a1's quadword at $v0 and move VU0 register vf1 into $v0 (qmfc2.ni); nothing calls or names it. The same words sit after eight other functions (StoreVectorTail and a file's role), the tail of a stripped vector function; it is classified handwritten only for its VU0 instruction

name: InitOutputBuffer
evidence: sets an output buffer's handle (+0x0C) and zeroes its target, capacity, used, count and pending words; PrintFormattedVa sets one up with handle -1 for the console

name: InitStringOutputBuffer
evidence: sets an output buffer up to write into memory: target and capacity from its arguments, used, count and pending 0 and handle -1 (FormatToStringVa, FormatToStringBoundedVa)

name: DestroyOutputBuffer
evidence: flushes the buffer with func_001D72C8 and, when flag bit 0 is set, frees it with func_0018D778

name: AppendToOutputBuffer
evidence: copies n bytes into target at used when a target is set, else into the 0x18 buffer, flushing at 0x400, and adds the count written to count

name: FlushOutputBuffer
evidence: writes the pending bytes of buf to the handle with func_001F9028 (or to func_001F7B88 in 0x80-byte pieces when handle is negative) and zeroes pending

name: InitPathFollower
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x19: runs InitSwitchedCollider, sets its distances (50.0, 50.0, 3000.0, 1300.0), its rate 2.0 and mode 3, copies its default vectors from D_00275290 and D_00275250 and resets it with ResetPathFollower

name: StartPathFollower
evidence: slot 16 of class 0x19: starts the placed object, resolves its links (D_002752A0), stores its heading, creates its state walker, starts the three engine sounds of worlds 3, 5 and 6, finds its class 0x104 partner, and for kind 1 points the 0x426 objects at it

name: StepPathFollower
evidence: slot 28 of class 0x19, its override of StepCollider

name: FindNearestValueOutsideSpans
evidence: returns x when func_001EB080 says no span of the array contains it, else the span end (lo or hi) nearest to x that no span contains

name: UpdatePathFollowerPace
evidence: moves the value at +0x85C toward the target at +0x860 and, once the time at +0x864 has passed, picks a new target from a clamped polynomial of lap and entry index plus a random offset and a random next time

name: GetWrappedDifference
evidence: returns lim - base, then subtracts or adds the period x when that difference lies beyond half of it in either direction

name: IsPathFollowerAhead
evidence: returns 1 when the first object's lap count at +0xB00 is greater than the other's, then compares the index of its current entry (+0xAF8, word at +0xC), then the wrapped difference of their positions along the path

name: AdvancePathFollowerAlongPath
evidence: original assembly: gathers the other followers (GatherObjectsById), compares their progress (IsPathFollowerAhead), finds the nearest time on its path curve (FindPathCurveNearestTime), keeps it out of the blocked spans (FindNearestValueOutsideSpans, IsInsideRange) and eases toward it (ApproachValueWithRamp, WrapModulo); UpdatePathFollower calls it

name: ComputePathFollowerHeadingTarget
evidence: original assembly: from the path (+0x830) at the follower's position (+0x83C) and pace (+0x85C) computes the heading to aim at (ArctangentOfRatio, func_001ED908) and stores it and its turn at 0x694 and 0x698; UpdatePathFollower calls it

name: SteerPathFollower
evidence: UpdatePathFollower's helper: eases the turn rate at +0x69C toward the clamped wrapped difference between the target heading at +0x694 and the heading of its first matrix row, and sets the value at +0x50 of each of the four slots at +0x6B0 to the speed at +0x698 over the radius at +0x610 (first two) or +0x614
